name: 陳家興
objective:
本課程旨在運用生成式 AI 進行文化議題研究、資料分析、敘事創作與策略制定，引導學生從文化觀點出發提出具創意與意義的文化內容提案。課程內容涵蓋 AI 輔助的文化資料蒐集、文化洞察萃取、視覺與影音生成、策略地圖建立與競賽實作。學生將以 A+ 文化資產競賽為核心任務，完成文化創意作品之策略分析、企劃與呈現，並於期末發展升級版文化創意提案。
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
This course introduces the application of generative AI in cultural research, data analysis, narrative creation, and strategic development. Students will learn how to integrate AI-assisted cultural data collection, insight generation, visual and video content creation, and strategic mapping into cultural creative proposals. Centered on preparing submissions for the A+ Cultural Heritage Competition, the course guides students in producing culturally grounded creative works supported by analytical strategies. By the end of the course, students will present an enhanced cultural innovation proposal demonstrating their capability in AI-driven cultural storytelling and strategic communication.

remarks: 本課程以實務導向進行，學生需以小組方式完成文化創意作品並提交競賽。由於進度緊湊，請務必穩定出席並參與團隊合作，以影響成果。課程將大量使用生成式 AI 進行文化資料分析、內容創作與策略規劃，請於開學前完成 Google Gemini Pro 學生版申請，以利課堂操作。This course is practice-oriented and requires group work to produce a cultural creative project for competition submission. Consistent attendance is important due to the intensive schedule and collaborative nature of the course. Generative AI tools will be used for analysis, creation, and strategy development. Please activate the Google Gemini Pro Student Plan before the semester begins to ensure smooth participation.
